history.text: Islam spread early through the Gulf of Tadjoura ports.
France consolidated the territory as French Somaliland.
The Addis Ababa railway made the port the outlet for Ethiopian trade.
Civil conflict ended in a power-sharing agreement.

worthSeeing.title: Lake Assal:
worthSeeing.text: A crater lake 155 m below sea level, the lowest point in Africa.

worthSeeing.title: Lake Abbe:
worthSeeing.text: Limestone chimneys venting steam on the Ethiopian border.

worthSeeing.title: Gulf of Tadjoura:
worthSeeing.text: Whale sharks gather seasonally in the bay near Arta.
